ai.context: The database of ntfy.sh, a pub-sub push notification service. Tables: user (accounts, role, tier_id, Stripe fields), tier (plans and limits), user_access (topic ACL: user_id, topic pattern, read/write), user_token (API tokens), user_email/user_phone, message (cached messages per topic; time and expires are unix seconds), message_stats. The anonymous user is u_everyone.
